Messages.Author: Tdog
Messages.Body:
I was looking at a topic on another question and I saw this at the end:

"Can I fetch "Ankara Citadel" with the "Alastor" vote, and put it on a ready Camarilla vampire?"

And the answer was "Yes".
I never thought about this before and I guess I haven't seen it in a game, but a question comes to mind from this.

Can specific requirements for an equipment be ignored with Alastor?

Can I use Jaroslav Pascek to get Ankara Citadel with Alastor?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Tdog wrote:
> Can specific requirements for an equipment be ignored with Alastor?
>
> Can I use Jaroslav Pascek to get Ankara Citadel with Alastor?
>
Yes. The vampire doesn't "equip" with the card, so he or she doesn't have to meet the requirements.
The equipment is simply "put" on the vampire.

Messages.Author: hardyrange
Messages.Body:
Alastor
Type: Political Action
Requires: justicar,inner circle
Requires a justicar or Inner Circle member.
Choose a ready Camarilla vampire. If this referendum is successful, search your library for an equipment card and place this card and the equipment on the chosen vampire. Pay half the cost (round down) of the equipment. This vampire may enter combat with any vampire controlled by another Methuselah as a +1 stealth  action. This vampire cannot commit diablerie. A vampire may have only one Alastor.

Messages.Author: Whisker
Messages.Body:
Hmm...
Play Fame on your pray's weenie cam vampire. Call Alastor vote on the unlucky sod and give him Eye of Hazimel.
Your pray now has to pay 1 during each of his untap phases, or burn the Eye and trigger fame. If your prey does not have cam vampire call the vote on your own vampire and get the Eye and start rushing people.

Eye of Hazimel

[3 Pool]

Unique equipment.
The minion with this equipment gets +1 bleed and +1 strength. This minion may enter combat with any minion controlled by another Methuselah as a  action. If this minion is a vampire, he or she has superior Potence [POT] and superior Chimerstry [CHI] , and combat cards cost this vampire 1 less blood. While the bearer is ready, this equipment cannot be transferred, moved or stolen. If this equipment is burned, this minion takes 5 unpreventable damage. During your untap phase, burn 1 pool or burn this equipment.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
I suppose you can, but I am no rule lawyer.

The real question being, in which situation do you want to do so ? If he has still quite a lot of pool, you risk him rushing you back or benefiting from the +1 bleed to kill its prey. If he have less than four pool, you could do this to have the same effect as an anarch revolt, but it seem extremely convoluted.

I suppose it's like cross-table ousting someone with Parity shift and giving the pool to your prey : yes, sometime it's useful to remember you can do that, but it's very narrow.

During undirected actions and actions that are not directed at this vampire, he or she cannot block or play reaction cards. A minion may have only one haven and only one vehicle.
